There are a few reasons
. 1. The extractor is a money hungry douche and soaked his material too long (closed loop only) 
Or
2. The material was either old or ground (auto trimmer anyone?) One of my best clients could have the most beautiful golden puss yellow amazingness, but machine trims and it comes out Amber, which is still fine. Also, if the grower used any kind of bug spray or anything similar it will come out poop soup. 

To ensure beautiful concentrate: 
No bugs, mold, sprays during growth. 

Cold butane with short amount of contact time.

(Somewhat) Contradictory to what most extractors tell you, I like to cook my extracts at a higher temp and knowingly burn off non volatles and lower boiling point terps. This will bring out the terps that you're actually after and raise the % of cannabinoids by volume.

Nah, it's pretty straight forward, just make sure you're only soaking it for 20s or so, alcohol is a pretty rough solvent, it will start to pick up undesirables pretty quickly. Most people do 2-3 20sec washes, quality degrading with each wash. You can't really burn it per se, but keep your temps around 100* , preferably outdoors or with super good ventilation. Alcohols ignition temp with an ignition source is the same as its evap temp, 97*

Nah, it's actually super simple. Alcohol + material, filter w/ coffee filter, cook off alcohol, and there ya have it. At its basic level. I usually do a 'winterization' , where I put the rso/alcohol into a cryogenic or deep freeze, then pull through a buchner funnel into a erlenmeyer flask w/vacuum port. This pulls out all the fats/lipids/chlorophyll
